_comment: Platform-level settings only. Engine tunables stay in engines/ml/configs/*.yaml (single source of truth for the ML engine).

env.REVIVE_DB: path to a DuckDB file; default data/db/revive_tery.duckdb
env.REVIVE_PLATFORM_ROOT: path to this folder; default derived from each module's location
env.REVIVE_ML_CACHE: raw dataset cache; keep OUTSIDE OneDrive

wokwi._comment: Set to the shared wokwi.com project URL after importing engines/firmware/wokwi; empty disables the button. The web app makes no request to Wokwi unless the user clicks.
